ammo.prompt: Create one landscape item illustration for a grounded military survival game's supply market, 3:2 composition. One centered subject, whole silhouette visible, occupying about 65 percent of the canvas width and height, with generous empty space. Three-quarter view from slightly above, consistent natural perspective. No lettering, labels, numerals, logos, watermarks, medical emblems, borders, people, hands, scenery or decorative interface. No blood, smoke, sparks or neon. All visible marks must belong to the stated illustration technique, not simulated photography. Subject: one compact open olive-green metal ammunition tin, lid raised behind it, containing orderly groups of brass rifle and pistol cartridges and two muted burgundy shotgun shells. A tightly composed small group of three cartridges rests immediately beside the tin. The tin is the dominant unified silhouette. No firearm and no gun magazine. General ammunition resupply. Art direction: HAND-PAINTED TACTICAL INVENTORY ILLUSTRATION, visibly not photorealistic. Paint broad deliberate brush strokes and angular planes of value, with selective crisp silhouette edges and lost edges in shadows. A plain deep charcoal background with a faint hand-painted tonal variation and a small painted grounding shadow. Premium editorial concept-art finish: painterly, calm, tactile and grounded, never cute or cartoonish. The image MUST unmistakably read as a painted illustration rather than a photograph, ray-traced render or digitally filtered photograph.
